reference.method: Read-only disassembly and matching PDB metadata. The executable was not run.

facts.contract: PlayerMovement::calculateMoveVector forms the movement vector from analog input or digital fallback, normalizes over-length analog input, and applies the sneaking factor. The observed client input callback writes this vector into MoveInputComponent.mMove. Item-use attenuation is performed by a separate component consumer.

The setup helper begins with 0.35f. For an item whose isComponentBased virtual method returns true, it calls ComponentItem::getMovementModifier. That getter returns 0.35f when UseModifiersItemComponent is absent, 1.0f when the component exists without its optional mMovementModifier, or the component's configured float when present. The helper writes the selected float into ItemUseSlowdownModifierComponent when its distance from 1.0f exceeds the observed float epsilon comparison.
anchors: getter optional presence test at component+0x4C

facts.contract: The observed consumer loads ItemUseSlowdownModifierComponent.mModifier, multiplies the float by itself, and multiplies both components of MoveInputComponent.mMove by that square. Thus the ordinary 0.35f modifier produces approximately 0.1225 input scaling. Applying the modifier only once would differ from this matched path.
anchors: PDB MoveInputComponent.mMove offset36 (0x24), second float offset40 (0x28)

comparison.default_factor: Perlin's ProcessMoveInput already squares its itemUseModifier argument. LocalPlayer supplies 0.35f for the active default item-use path. This coefficient and square are consistent with the matched native consumer; no production factor change was made for this investigation.
comparison.existing_regressions: tests/physics_selftest.cpp checks 0.1225 axial and normalized diagonal input for the default modifier and steady movement under use slowdown. The isolated physics selftest passed after the slow-falling numeric regressions were added.
comparison.remaining_metadata_gap: LocalPlayer still supplies a fixed default modifier rather than a per-item UseModifiersItemComponent value. Correct start/stop gating of active item use is a separate interaction-state change. This evidence does not establish that every item uses the default coefficient.

limitations: These static facts are specific to the matched 1.26.51.1/protocol2193 executable; equivalence with the incident's protocol2225 client build has not been established here.

The setup and consumer are connected by their identified component storage and field layout. This artifact does not reconstruct every condition that creates, removes or filters that component, or every scheduler/replay mode.
This artifact does not establish full custom-item metadata conversion, full movement trajectories, server acceptance, or a cause for the reported disconnect.
